bluetooth_confirm.title: Indoor bike
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Home Assistant won't connect to it until you turn on its session switch, so apps like Kinomap and Zwift keep working as before.

user.title: Indoor bike
user.description: Pick the bike. Only bikes Home Assistant can hear right now are listed, so pedal for a moment first to wake the console. Setting up doesn't connect to it.

abort.already_configured: This bike is already set up.
abort.not_a_bike: This fitness machine isn't an indoor bike.
abort.no_bikes: No indoor bikes can be heard right now. Pedal for a moment to wake the console, then try again.

init.title: Options
init.description: Most bikes need none of these. They're for a bike nothing else connects to, like the spare Bluetooth module on a console that has two: Home Assistant can then watch every ride without getting in the way of the app running it.

data_description.watch_only: Never send the bike commands, so the app running the ride keeps control. The target resistance and target power controls go away.
data_description.auto_session: Connect whenever the bike is heard, instead of waiting for the Session switch. While this is on, an app can't connect to this bike, so only turn it on for a bike the app doesn't use. Switching a session off keeps it off until the console goes to sleep.
data_description.resistance_scale: Consoles read the resistance command in one of two ways, and nothing the bike reports says which. If setting a level lands on a different level on the console, try the other one. Automatic picks spread for consoles with more than 25 levels.

options.tenths: Tenths of a level (the FTMS standard)
